description: AI-powered customer communications and cloud phone system platform providing voice, SMS, and messaging APIs
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public marketplace apps; HTTP Basic Auth (using api_id and api_token) or Bearer token for private apps and customer integrations
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial to access developer tools and test the API, but full API usage requires a paid plan (Essentials, Professional, or Enterprise starting at $30-$50/license/month)
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering users, teams, calls, conversations, outbound campaigns, SMS, WhatsApp, conversation intelligence, analytics reports, webhooks, and embedded CTI SDK
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Aircall directly; docs mention AI/MCP guides coming soon or framework readiness
rationale: Aircall provides a robust, publicly documented REST API and webhooks with self-serve trial access, though full production usage requires a paid subscription plan.

evidence.note: Documents OAuth for technology partners and Basic Auth with api_id/api_token for customers
Details subscription plans (Essentials, Professional, Enterprise) and free trials / free access
Complete public REST API reference for users, calls, conversations, analytics, webhooks, and messaging
Lists platform capabilities including classic integrations, webhooks, and embedded SDK
